title: Composites of standard ph families admit a standard refinement
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme and work with schemes over $S$ [def-pc-scheme] in the universes [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $T$ be affine, meaning isomorphic to the spectrum of a commutative ring. Let $p:U\to T$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and surjective on points, with a finite affine open covering $U=\bigcup_{j=1}^{m}U_j$. For each $j$, let $q_j:V_j\to U_j$ be proper and surjective on points, with a finite affine open covering $V_j=\bigcup_{i=1}^{n_j}V_{ji}$. Then there exist a proper surjection $r:Z\to T$, a finite affine open covering $Z=\bigcup_{a=1}^{N}Z_a$, and, for each $a$, indices $j(a),i(a)$ and a $T$-morphism $Z_a\to V_{j(a)i(a)}$. Thus each $Z_a\to T$ factors through one composite $V_{ji}\to U_j\to T$. Open coverings mean coverings by open subschemes [def-weil-open-immersion]. Zero-length covers are permitted only when the covered scheme is empty; all index sets are small.
